image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a car wheel installed on a vehicle. The wheel features a multi-spoke alloy rim with a polished/silver finish and a central logo cap. A rubber tire is mounted on the rim, showing sidewall details and partial tread. The wheel is situated within a white wheel well/fender arch. The image has a warm, sepia-toned filter applied.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflection on the white bodywork above the wheel appears slightly smeared and lacks sharp definition, possibly indicating minor generative blur or over-smoothing in the background elements.

Some of the inner connections where the spokes meet the outer barrel appear slightly soft or indistinct, lacking the crisp mechanical precision expected of a machined alloy wheel, though this could be due to depth-of-field blur.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of wheel (alloy vs steel) and verify class alignment with high confidence.
To verify the spatial relationship between the wheel and the wheel well, ensuring the wheel sits correctly 'inside' the arch without floating or clipping.
To check for fused spokes or broken topology in the complex spoke design, which is a common failure mode in AI-generated mechanical parts.

focus_areas: Symmetry and consistency of the multi-spoke design
Sharpness of the boundary between the tire sidewall and the rim lip
Logical continuity of reflections on the metallic surfaces
Presence of any warped or melted geometry in the spoke structure
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the symmetry of the spokes. AI often fails to maintain perfect rotational symmetry in alloy wheels. Check if the number of spokes is consistent and if they converge logically at the center hub. Also, verify that the tire does not 'melt' into the rim at the bead seat.
